info.description: Testing environment only. Covers the Announcement resource — see vWebsite-plg-AnnouncementAPI.html for the full field reference, error codes, and status behavior. Authentication is handled automatically by the Postman Interceptor Chrome extension once you're logged into the product in Chrome — see the HTML guide's Postman setup section.
